courses.overview: 從「Boeing 787 複材與電力系統」延伸到兩項可直接開啟的逐步課程；下列比較分別說明相似原理、差異與驗證練習，並附代表地點、地址或地理描述與近似座標。
courses.overviewEn: Extend Boeing 787 composites and electrical integration into two directly accessible guided courses. Each comparison identifies shared principles, differences and verification exercises, with a representative location, address or geographical descriptor and approximate coordinates.

related.title: Airbus A350 複材客機系統工程
related.why: 把「Boeing 787 複材與電力系統」與「Airbus A350 複材客機系統工程」對照，先辨認能沿用的原理，再檢查不能直接移植的設計條件。
related.whyEn: Compare Boeing 787 composites and electrical integration with Airbus A350 composite airliner systems: identify transferable principles, then check design conditions that cannot be transferred directly.

place.name: 土魯斯布拉尼亞克機場周邊（首飛代表地點）
place.nameEn: Toulouse–Blagnac Airport area — representative first-flight location
place.coordinateScope: 公開代表定位點，座標為近似值；依地點可能是工程、園區、博物館、入口或城市，並非整體工程邊界。
place.coordinateScopeEn: Approximate public reference point: a project, campus, museum, entrance or city depending on the entry, not the boundary of the entire project.

related.transfer: 兩種複材客機都要把纖維方向、接頭、損傷檢測和系統安裝一起考慮。
related.transferEn: Both composite airliners integrate fiber orientation, joints, damage inspection and system installation.
related.difference: A350 與 787 的機身製造分段及機電配置不同；複材占比不能直接決定維修程序或電力架構。
related.differenceEn: A350 and 787 differ in fuselage manufacturing divisions and system architecture; composite percentage alone does not determine repair procedures or electrical design.
practice: 比較板件與筒段的概念接口
標記接頭與線束可能交會的位置
為內部損傷選擇可驗證證據
practiceEn: Compare conceptual panel and barrel interfaces
Mark intersections of joints and wiring

related.title: 特斯拉與電動汽車工程
related.why: 把「Boeing 787 複材與電力系統」與「特斯拉與電動汽車工程」對照，先辨認能沿用的原理，再檢查不能直接移植的設計條件。
related.whyEn: Compare Boeing 787 composites and electrical integration with Tesla and Electric Vehicle Engineering: identify transferable principles, then check design conditions that cannot be transferred directly.

place.name: Tesla Fremont 工廠
place.mapQuery: Tesla Fremont Factory, 45500 Fremont Boulevard, Fremont CA 94538, USA
place.address: Tesla Fremont Factory, 45500 Fremont Boulevard, Fremont CA 94538, USA
place.addressEn: Tesla Fremont Factory, 45500 Fremont Boulevard, Fremont CA 94538, USA
place.coordinateScope: 公開代表定位點，座標為近似值；依地點可能是工程、園區、博物館、入口或城市，並非整體工程邊界。
place.coordinateScopeEn: Approximate public reference point: a project, campus, museum, entrance or city depending on the entry, not the boundary of the entire project.

related.transfer: 更多功能改由電力驅動後，配電、功率轉換、散熱和故障隔離成為整機共同問題。
related.transferEn: Electrifying more functions makes distribution, conversion, cooling and fault isolation system-wide concerns.
related.difference: 電動車以電池儲能牽引；787 仍以航空燃油驅動發動機並產生電力，不能稱作電池電動飛機。
related.differenceEn: An EV stores traction energy in batteries; the 787 still uses fuel-powered engines and electrical generation, so it is not a battery-electric aircraft.
practice: 畫出燃料與電池的能量來源
比較電力分配和推進的關係
為兩種系統標示一個散熱瓶頸
practiceEn: Draw fuel and battery energy sources
Mark one cooling bottleneck in each system

courses.summary: 787 將大尺寸複材結構與更多電力系統整合進大型民航機。南卡羅來納州基地是這項供應鏈與總裝工程的地面代表；首飛則發生於華盛頓州 Everett，兩個地點不可混為同一事件。
courses.summaryEn: The 787 combines large composite structures with more-electric systems. The South Carolina campus represents its supply and assembly engineering; first flight occurred in Everett, Washington, a different place.
courses.connection: 把基地看作材料、分段運輸、總裝與檢驗的交會點，再與 A350 課程比較共通的複材與介面問題。
courses.connectionEn: View the campus as a meeting point for materials, section transport, assembly and inspection; compare shared composite and interface challenges with the A350 course.

roles.role: 787 的製造商與系統整合者。
roles.roleEn: Manufacturer and systems integrator of the 787.
roles.business: 製造商用客機、國防航空器（含 AH-64 阿帕契）與太空系統。
roles.businessEn: Builds commercial jetliners, defence aircraft (including the AH-64 Apache) and space systems.

roles.role: 787 碳纖維複材的主要材料供應商。
roles.roleEn: Principal carbon-fibre composite material supplier for the 787.
roles.business: 碳纖維複材與水處理 RO 膜製造商。
roles.businessEn: Maker of carbon-fibre composites and RO water-treatment membranes.

roles.role: 旗下 Collins Aerospace（前 Hamilton Sundstrand）供應 787 電力產生與分配系統。
roles.roleEn: Its Collins Aerospace (ex-Hamilton Sundstrand) supplies the 787 electric power generation and distribution system.
roles.business: 航太國防集團（Raytheon、Collins、Pratt & Whitney），併入 BBN 等網路研究傳統。
roles.businessEn: Aerospace and defence group (Raytheon, Collins, Pratt & Whitney) that absorbed BBN’s networking heritage.

courses.connection: 從「Boeing 787 複材與電力系統」的材料、設備、設計、量測或系統整合問題，延伸查閱下列公司與機構的官方資料；這是教材關聯，不代表合作、採購、背書或投資建議。
courses.connectionEn: Explore official information from companies and institutions related to the materials, equipment, design, measurement or system integration in Boeing 787 composites and electrical integration. This is a learning association, not a partnership, procurement, endorsement or investment advice.

vendors.businessEn: The manufacturer’s AH-64 overview gives rotorcraft integration and maintenance context; this course remains at general aeronautical principles. This is a public product/service learning reference, not a procurement or contractor list for this course.
